title: My headphones played a recording of me sleeping 🎧
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:02 in the morning my headphones started playing a recording of me sleeping.

scenes.narration: At 3:02 in the morning my headphones started playing a recording of me sleeping.
I had fallen asleep with them on the bedside table, not in my ears. The sound came out thin and small, like a voice in a tin can.
I listened. My breathing, slow and even. Then, under it, a second breath. A fraction of a second behind mine, like an echo that had learned to walk.
I pressed stop. The recording kept going. I pulled out the cable. It kept going. I put the headphones in the drawer and the sound followed me down the hall.
In the kitchen I picked up the phone. The voice memo app was open, and a file was recording. Duration, four hours and nineteen minutes. Started at midnight.
I tapped the waveform to see where the second breath began. A tiny flag sat on the timeline. Added by you, three nights ago.
I did not add anything three nights ago. I did not know anyone else had the app open. I held the phone to my ear and heard my own voice whispering, he is awake now.
The recording stopped. The kitchen light blinked once. And in the hallway, very softly, someone began to breathe in time with me.
So tell me. Do you answer the voice, or wait for it to speak again?
